curated-special-elite-gf-noto-sans-kharo: Special Elite's lowercase fills the line (a band tour t-shirt, maybe). Noto Sans Kharoshthi lays a thick, dark stripe of text beneath, its curves staying open, so the distressed top gets footing.
curated-special-elite-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Special Elite's wide-mouthed a gives its distressed headlines real attitude. Noto Sans Lisu stays out of the way, its wide-open s curves keeping text tidy while the rough heading takes every bit of the attention.
curated-special-elite-gf-noto-sans-manda: Rough-edged and brash, Special Elite's big x-height crowds the line, and Noto Sans Mandaic's curvy lowercase reaches nearly to capital height. But Special Elite earns its keep big and brief, a word or two of worn-out attitude.
curated-special-elite-gf-noto-sans-meete: Scuffed and loud, Special Elite fills the line, ready for a bandcamp page header. Noto Sans Meetei Mayek goes down easily across a full page, its big lowercase eyes and gapped rounds keeping things modern.
curated-special-elite-gf-noto-sans-meroi: Noto Sans Meroitic reads friendly and plain-spoken, its lowercase filling the line like capitals, say, for a vinyl record label. Special Elite can shout above while those see-through c openings keep text moving.
curated-special-elite-gf-noto-sans-myanm: Clean and steady, Noto Sans Myanmar runs a thick strip of text. Under Special Elite's scuffed, distressed headings, its broad-mouthed c gives the eye somewhere welcoming to settle after the rough start.
curated-special-elite-gf-noto-sans-pahaw: Gritty and showy, Special Elite suits, say, a poster print shop merch table. Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong's rounds gap like a cracked bangle, and that tidy, contemporary quirk against the rowdy heading is the hook.
curated-special-elite-gf-noto-serif-guja: Bookish and authoritative, the text face keeps its stroke changes slight, so Special Elite gets the loud jobs, say, a bandcamp page header. Noto Serif Gujarati handles the long, careful reading.
curated-special-elite-gf-noto-serif-sinh: Special Elite brings a wide-mouthed a and a lowercase that fills the line, all scuffed and distressed up top. Noto Serif Sinhala's gentle stroke shifts supply the refined, bookish counterweight.
curated-special-elite-gf-odor-mean-chey: Special Elite's wide-mouthed a and big x-height read scruffy and loose (handy for a songwriter lyric sheet). Odor Mean Chey pinches the mouths of its a, s and e, giving the open heading a dignified, editorial counterweight.
